notice: Command lines a template may not contain (data, D-58; action-templates 9.3). A line is lowercased, runs of spaces are collapsed, and it is refused when it starts with one of the patterns; * matches any text. 'everywhere' applies to every command line of a custom action (run, rollback, check before, read-back); 'read_only_steps' also applies to the check before and the read-back of every action, which must not change anything.
